info.title: CanFactory API
info.description: Local parametric STL generation. Dimensions are millimetres. Generated jobs and files expire one hour after creation; there are no saved user designs.

artifactFormat.description: The shape of the generated file: one STL, or a ZIP of one STL per part.

customizable.description: Whether this model exposes adjustable parameters yet.

get.summary: Get a model and its editor schema

artifactFormat.description: The shape of the generated file: one STL, or a ZIP of one STL per part.

customizable.description: Whether this model exposes adjustable parameters yet.

maximum.description: Upper bound of a number; for a text control, the most characters allowed.

options.description: The allowed values of an enum control, in display order; null for other kinds.

bands.description: Named sub-ranges of a number control, in order, from minimum (included) to maximum (excluded, except for the last): the editor names the one the value is in. Null for none.

control.description: The key of an enum control of the same model.

recommended.description: For a number control, the sub-range recommended for each value of another (enum) control: the editor highlights it on the slider. Advice only; values outside it stay valid. Null for none.

parameterSchema.description: JSON Schema for this model’s parameter object.

referenceUrl.description: Absent when this model has no small, permanent original file.

parts.description: Present only for multi-part assembly models, in render/ZIP order.

position.description: Translation in mm, applied after the rotation.

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees about the part’s own origin, applied about X, then Y, then Z.

title.description: Short caption, e.g. “Close the mini box”.

parts.description: The part ids that move together in this step.

from.description: Offset in mm at which the parts start this step; they end it at their assembled pose.

lift.description: Height in mm of the exploded layout above the print bed.

200.description: STL bytes; coordinates are in millimetres.

post.summary: Reuse a cached STL or enqueue generation
post.description: Returns 200 for a completed cached render or 202 for queued/running work. All fields are required. Poll the returned ID; retry explicitly after failure. No user designs are saved.

modelVersion.description: Version returned by the catalogue. Refresh the catalogue on a version conflict.

trapDiameter.title: Funnel diameter
trapDiameter.description: Outer diameter at the wide end, excluding the brim, in mm.

brimWidth.title: Brim width
brimWidth.description: Radial width extending outward on each side of the funnel, in mm.

nozzleDiameter.title: Central opening
nozzleDiameter.description: Inner diameter of the opening at the narrow end, in mm.

slotsEnabled.title: Ventilation slots
slotsEnabled.description: Distribute small slots automatically over the funnel. Disable for a smooth wall.

wallThickness.title: Wall thickness
wallThickness.description: Thickness of the funnel wall and brim in mm.

handles.title: Brim handles
handles.description: Add two opposing handles, sized with the brim.

gapHeight.title: Slot height
gapHeight.description: Vertical height of each ventilation slot in mm.

gapWidth.title: Slot width
gapWidth.description: Width of each ventilation slot in mm.

gapDistanceHorizontal.title: Horizontal spacing
gapDistanceHorizontal.description: Target spacing between slots around each layer, in mm.

gapDistanceVertical.title: Vertical spacing
gapDistanceVertical.description: Target spacing between slot layers, in mm.

parameters.description: Fruit fly trap parameters. All fields are required; dimensions are in millimetres.

modelVersion.description: Version returned by the catalogue. Refresh the catalogue on a version conflict.

towerDiameter.title: Tower diameter
towerDiameter.description: Outer diameter of the lattice segments and cover cap, in mm. Every part is scaled to it, so all parts fit together. The original design is 52 or 100.

spikeLength.title: Ground spike length
spikeLength.description: Overall length of the ground spike in mm. At least 60 mm for a 52 mm tower, growing in proportion to the tower diameter (the original 52 mm spike is 124 mm).

shortRauteRows.title: Short lattice rows
shortRauteRows.description: Rows of diamonds in the short lattice segment. The height grows by about 17.5 mm per row (the original has 4).

tallRauteRows.title: Tall lattice rows
tallRauteRows.description: Rows of diamonds in the tall lattice segment. The height grows by about 17.5 mm per row (the original has 10).

rauteColumns.title: Lattice columns
rauteColumns.description: Struts around both lattice segments. 0 chooses automatically from the tower diameter (6 at 52 mm, 12 at 100 mm); otherwise 4 to 16.

parameters.description: Moss planter parameters. Lengths are in millimetres. All fields are required.

modelVersion.description: Version returned by the catalogue. Refresh the catalogue on a version conflict.

snap.title: Snap mechanism
snap.description: How the parts hold together: a plain close fit, a detent, a flexible clip, magnets or crush ribs. It applies to every joint that supports it.

engraveText.title: Underside text
engraveText.description: Text on the underside of the large box, one line, up to 20 characters (letters, digits, spaces and punctuation, no accents). Leave empty for none.

textFont.title: Text font
textFont.description: The font of the underside text. All are bold, so that the strokes print cleanly.

textSize.title: Text size
textSize.description: Letter height of the underside text in mm (the height of a capital letter). Longer text needs a smaller size.

textMode.title: Text style
textMode.description: Engraved into the box, or carved and filled by a separate part for a second filament.

clearance.title: Clearance
clearance.description: Gap per side between parts that fit together (lid on box, mini box in the lid, holder in the box), in mm. Larger is looser; raise it if your printer prints parts that are too tight.

parameters.description: Cigarette case parameters. All fields are required.

modelVersion.description: Version returned by the catalogue. Refresh the catalogue on a version conflict.

pocketWidth.title: Pocket width
pocketWidth.description: Wide side of each pocket in mm: the plank width plus clearance. The default fits a 50.20 mm plank with 0.02 mm to spare.

pocketThickness.title: Pocket thickness
pocketThickness.description: Thin side of each pocket in mm: the plank thickness plus clearance. The default fits a 4.80 mm plank exactly.

insertionDepth.title: Insertion depth
insertionDepth.description: How far each plank end goes into the connector, in mm.

screwHoles.title: Screw holes
screwHoles.description: Optional through-holes across the wide faces, to screw or bolt each plank in place, sized for the chosen metric screw per DIN EN 20273. Drill the planks to match.

holeFit.title: Hole fit
holeFit.description: The DIN EN 20273 series of the screw holes (when there are holes).

holesPerEnd.title: Holes per plank
holesPerEnd.description: Screw holes per plank end, spread evenly across the pocket width (when there are holes).

wallThickness.title: Wall thickness
wallThickness.description: Material around the pockets on every side, in mm.

stopThickness.title: Centre stop
stopThickness.description: Thickness of the solid stop between the two pockets, in mm. 0 makes an open sleeve that the planks can slide through.

entryChamfer.title: Entry chamfer
entryChamfer.description: Size of the 45° lead-in at each pocket opening, in mm, which eases the plank in. 0 for none.

parameters.description: Plank connector parameters. All fields are required; dimensions are in millimetres.
